== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[FX-10 (Effex-ten) (PC 2023 D-E1 card)]]. Compared with the printed card [[FX-10 (Effex-ten)]] (Decipher, November 1996): the whole earlier card image and the whole of this card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
